message: Relief u/s 89(1) of {{relief}} has been claimed without furnishing Form 10E. Form 10E must be filed separately before the return is submitted, otherwise the relief may not be allowed.
remediation: File Form 10E on the e-filing portal, then record that it has been filed together with its acknowledgement number.
source: The assessee has claimed relief u/s 89(1) without furnishing of Form 10E
